title: Minimum Number of Operations to Make Array XOR Equal to K
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and a positive integer k, find the minimum number of bit flips required to make the bitwise XOR of all elements in the array equal to k.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and a positive integer k, find the minimum number of bit flips required to make the bitwise XOR of all elements in the array equal to k. You are allowed to flip any bit in any element of the array.
constraints: Flip any individual bit in any array element.
Make the XOR of all elements equal k.
Return the minimum number of bit flips.
hints: XOR all nums together, then XOR with k to mark differing target bits.
One input-bit flip changes exactly one bit of the aggregate XOR.
Count set bits in that difference mask.
Every differing bit needs one flip, and flipping it in any one element is sufficient.
editorial: Every differing bit needs one flip, and flipping it in any one element is sufficient.

tests.explanation: The current XOR differs from one in two bit positions, so two flips suffice.
The current XOR is already zero.
